description: Stage S1 gold evaluation set, hand-written (30 Oct 2026). One entry per question; parts in order. fact_type and period list the acceptable values. publisher_domains: any one should serve an official part; must_not_domains: other countries' authorities that must not serve it. expected: figures or terms the answer should contain, from knowledge as of mid-2026, unverified until checked live (verify_live). holdout: one question in three per group, never used to tune rules; fresh_holdout: 29 more written 30 Oct before the S2b fixes, after the original held-back failures had been seen; holdout3 (40, untouched) and dev2 (40, tuning) written 30 Oct before the S2c fixes. expected_status: every expected figure is pending authoritative verification and is not approved ground truth. holdout4 (40, untouched) written 30 Oct before the E1 rule-table classifier. holdout5 (40, untouched) written before the E2 model run and prompt. holdout6 (40, untouched) written before the set-6 confirmation run and its guards. holdout7 (30, untouched) written before the domains-from-countries confirmation. set8_tune (40) and set8_hold (40, untouched) and trial (80, the E3 trial questions relabelled; seen, a regression check) written 31 Oct under the approved labelling rules, before the S8 code changes. set9_tune (40) and set9_hold (40, untouched) written 30 Oct before the set-9 changes.
